name_reason: Follows fd2_<descriptor> convention and matches the file-local sibling fd2_show_miss_indicator; descriptor accurately reflects 'enqueue a floating damage number FX'. No address residue. Keep.
purpose: Enqueue a 4-digit right-aligned floating-damage (or heal) number over a target's battle tile by appending four FX queue slots, one per decimal place.
logic_summary: Primes an 8-byte stack work buffer from the '    \0' template @ 0x52045 (5 bytes), sets magnitude_threshold=3 and digit_pos=0. Reads the target runtime-char's pos_x/pos_y and applies an asymmetric viewport cull (x: origin_x-1 exclusive lower / origin_x+max_x exclusive upper; y: origin_y-1 inclusive lower / origin_y+max_y inclusive upper); if culled it returns without touching the queue count. Otherwise loops digit_iter 0..3 (magnitude_threshold stepping 3..0): re-formats the full number with sprintf("%d"), writes x_offset_queue[base+i]=i*5+2 and target_char_idx_queue[base+i]=target_idx; if strlen(num)>magnitude_threshold it writes sprite_id_queue[base+i]=marker_char+num[digit_pos]-'0' and advances digit_pos, else blanks the slot (sprite_id 0). Finally advances spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx by 4. The queue is later consumed/animated by fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_show_damage_number(uint param_1, uint param_2, uint param_3)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: amount: the numeric value to display (a resolved damage or heal value); formatted via sprintf("%d") and split into per-digit sprite ids.
params.reason: Generic Ghidra placeholder param_1; src already names it 'amount'. Caller sites pass the resolved damage/heal magnitude. Rename to amount (apply in Stage 2).

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: marker_char: sprite-id base added to each digit value; '^' (0x5E) red attack/magic damage, 'i' (0x69) green heal/positive, '_' suppress.
params.reason: Generic Ghidra placeholder param_2; src already names it 'marker_char'. Used as sprite_id = marker_char + digit - '0'. Rename to marker_char (apply in Stage 2).

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: target_idx: index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr whose tile the number floats over; also stored into target_char_idx_queue.
params.reason: Generic Ghidra placeholder param_3; src already names it 'target_idx'. Indexes the runtime-char array for the cull position and is the per-slot target. Rename to target_idx (apply in Stage 2).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect only: appends four entries to the floating-damage FX queues and advances spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx by 4 (or no-op if the target is culled).
